topography.project_purpose: Liquid Staking. Structurally: 44 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 3 ERC20 tokens, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on solmate.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 3 common project-authored base contract(s) (base, baseabstract, erc20upgradeable). Dominant framework: solmate.
